meta.title: FINALS HQ · THE FINALS leaderboards and profiles
meta.description: Leaderboards, profiles and progression of THE FINALS players, tracked every 10 minutes. Fan project, not affiliated with Embark Studios.
meta.leaderboardDescription: THE FINALS {board} leaderboard ({season}): rank, score and progression of every player, sortable and filterable.

common.notAffiliated: Fan project, not affiliated with Embark Studios. THE FINALS is a trademark of Embark Studios AB.
common.source: Data: public leaderboards via api.the-finals-leaderboard.com, tracked every 10 minutes.

freshness.stale: Last snapshot {age}. Leaderboards may have moved since.
freshness.outdated: Last snapshot {age}: collection looks interrupted, showing the last known data.
freshness.rejected: Recent files were rejected (API format changed?).

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.loadError: Could not load the full leaderboard.
leaderboard.emptyHint: Try another league or club tag.
leaderboard.emptyBoard: This leaderboard is empty for now.
leaderboard.archived: Season over: final standings{date, select, none {} other { (snapshot of {date})}}.
leaderboard.pageIntro: Current season tracked every 10 minutes, past seasons frozen at their last snapshot.

search.title: Search
search.label: Embark name (e.g. GOJO#6255)
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters. Typos are tolerated from 3.
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} for “{q}”
search.noneHint: This player may not be in the top 10,000: public leaderboards stop there.
search.paletteHint: Ctrl K or ⌘ K to open, Esc to close
search.error: Search is not responding. Try again in a moment.
search.rateLimited: Too many searches in a row. Try again in a minute.

home.title: Find a player, follow the season.
home.intro: The top 10,000 ranked players of THE FINALS, tracked every 10 minutes.
home.top500Hint: RS of the 500th player, the bar to clear for the top of the board.
home.moversEmpty: 7-day change shows up after one week of tracking (since 5 Nov 2026).
home.distributionHint: Players per division at the last snapshot; the league comes from the API.

status.title: Data status
status.intro: The pipeline: the collector polls the API every 10 minutes, the worker loads it into the database, the site reads the database.

player.hidden: Profile hidden at the player's request.
